- Overestimate prices in bullish sentiment periods (positive sentiment > 0.10) — reduce forecast by 2–5% for 30-day horizon.
- Underestimate prices after sharp spikes (e.g., >85) — adjust downward by 3–8% if sentiment is neutral or slightly negative.
- Overshoots in early forecast window (days 1–7) are common — apply a 1–3% downward correction if sentiment is positive.
- Mean reversion bias: if forecast is >10% above recent 7-day average, reduce by 5–10% if sentiment is weak or negative.
- Lagged sentiment effect: if sentiment drops >0.20 in last 3 days, reduce forecast by 3–6% for next 7 days.
- Avoid overconfidence in high sentiment + high recent prices — cap forecast at 10% below 30-day high if sentiment >0.20.
- For 30-day horizon, if true outcome is consistently 5–10% below forecast, reduce next forecast by 2–4% unless sentiment is strong.
